title: Under The Carriage
paragraphs: “Hm?”

Popping out were monsters that I hadn’t seen before in this Activation site. When we returned to the laboratory, a sphere of spatial distortion, which usually appears when the boss of an Activation site emerges, was floating.
“Right! The Wave!”
As I gazed absentmindedly at this newly liberated land for a while, Father spoke.
“…It looks like it’s over.”
Upon checking, it seems the Wave has ended. Does that mean things went well on that side too?
“That means the village is safe too, right?”
“Seems like it. They’ve grown stronger than we expected.”
“That’s right.”
Of course! After all, the Filolials were with them!
“Still, to think someone could artificially create a Wave… Maybe they were accelerating the arrival of the Waves?”
“Initially, it was just an investigation for experience points, but we gained far more than that.”
“True. Even if things loop again, taking this place down would still be beneficial.”
With the ruins of the desert’s fallen capital under a rainbow, we basked in the sweet taste of victory.
“Alright, let’s start the investigation. I doubt the treasure the demons gathered ends here.”
“Agreed.”

Father and the others pointed to the area beneath where System Experience had sealed off. There, a staircase was revealed, leading down to a treasure vault. Inside was an overwhelming collection of various weapons that couldn’t possibly fit in one place. There was everything, from armor to accessories. Some of the accessories even had effects that could be considered downright unfair. The problem, however, was that many were cursed, so dispelling those curses would be the first step, though that shouldn’t take too long.
“Moira has been found!”
Itsuki had a beaming expression as he rummaged through the treasure vault. Apparently, a lot of culturally significant weapons of immense value had been discovered.
“Treasures! Gaelion wants them all!”
Rival, on the other hand, was overflowing with desire upon seeing the mountain of treasure. I definitely don’t want to end up like that.
“Yaaah!”
“Kou wants the shiny ones too!”
“It’s so beautiful! Motoyasu-sama! Yuki thinks it’s beautiful too, right?”
“Gold isn’t to Kuro’s taste.”
These treasures belong to the Filolials! Not a single piece will be given to a dragon!
“Well, this is something…”
“Treasure tempts everyone equally—be it humans, dragons, or Filolials.”
Ren wrapped things up with that remark.
“Anyway, we did it! Naofumi-sama! Raphtalia-chan!”
Big Sister’s friend was dancing on top of Father’s shield in celebration. Big Sister held hands with her big sister, both of them smiling brightly.
“Has the world become a little better now?”
“Seems like it.”
“Yeah. Let’s head back and report. This place is going to get busy soon.”

And so, it turned out that this Activation site, the Prado Desert, was an unknown location that provided a massive amount of experience points. What’s more, when we returned, we learned a surprising fact—Activation sites all over the world had reactivated, and the experience gained worldwide had doubled. Furthermore, the lands that had been ravaged by the Waves were now showing signs of regeneration, and even the food shortages had resolved themselves without our intervention.

It seems that the village side was also nearly a complete victory. Since Keel and the others had experienced multiple Waves before, they were able to use that experience to fight smoothly against this one. Unlike the usual Waves, a large number of demons appeared this time, but at the same time, the Staff Hero, Trash, also showed up and slaughtered the demons. Without missing a beat, Fiancée and Éclair rushed in, and after that, it was just a matter of mopping them up.

With that, we moved to develop the Prado Desert on a large scale as a new stronghold, bringing in personnel from various countries. Ah, unlike Big Sister’s village, this won’t be led by the Hero. It seems a post town will be built, primarily for adventurers aiming to gain experience points. Nowadays, the world has changed so that levels can increase rapidly with just a little experience.

The reputation of the Heroes in the world has skyrocketed. Discovering lost weapons, finding new Activation sites, and doubling the experience points on a global scale—these achievements have spread far and wide. As a result, the heroic deeds of the Heroes have echoed throughout the world.

Incidentally, I later heard from Father and Big Sister that, thanks to defeating the System Experience, it has become difficult for reincarnators to enter this world so easily. Apparently, there was some sort of gap in the system. It seems the System Experience was managing that aspect as well. And so, the days passed by.
“Iwatani Rifana is missing!”
This happened one day while I was training the Filolials in the Prado Desert. The Filolials we had raised and Big Sister’s group had started playing hide-and-seek. I was making clothes for everyone.

It seems that Kou was the one playing the seeker and was searching for everyone. Ah, by the way, after the incident was resolved, the villagers would sometimes accompany us. With the long-lasting effects of the Activation site, people had been coming and going frequently.
“Rifana-chan is missing?”
“Yeah… I found all the others, but I can’t find Rifana anywhere.”
Father turned his eyes to Big Sister and Keel.
“The Filolials are easy to find because they chirp when they hide, and humans can’t shrink, so they’re easy to spot, but Rifana is…” Keel responded with a troubled expression.
Indeed. After all, she transforms into a small weasel.
“Even Raphtalia-chan?”
“Yes… Rifana-chan has become even more athletic since she got stronger, and she’s gotten really good at hiding.”
“Well… she plays energetically with Kou every day. She’s even faster than Raphtalia-chan, who used to pride herself on her speed.”
“Yes… Naofumi-sama, can’t you find her?”
“Wouldn’t she come out if you called for surrender?”
“That’s not how this game works… We just have to wait for her to come out.”
“Well, that’s a bummer.”
“I thought big brother might be able to find her!”
Father answered with a troubled expression. Of course. Father could find her in an instant.
“Since she’s a weasel, can’t you track her by scent?”
“Rifana-chan is very particular about that. She’s really good at hunting, right? Honestly, Kou is…”
“Hm?”
Kou tilted his head.
“Well, whatever. I’ll go look for her. Motoyasu, you’re… making clothes for the Filolials?”
“Indeed.”

I was sewing clothes to match the needs of the Filolials. With that, Father joined the search. We had set a search area, but since it was Big Sister’s friend who could shrink, after all. In the worst-case scenario, she might have hidden in Kou’s feathers. Just as I was thinking that, Father peeked under the carriage.
“But… while resting is fine…”

Father gazed at the Filolials running around and playing in the desert. It was no longer as hot as a desert, even during the day. If we planted bio-plants here, the land would soon be overflowing with greenery. In fact, it seemed that the greenery was already gradually spreading.
“Filo-tan still hasn’t been found.”
“Indeed…”

Ren and Itsuki also helped me, and the environment has been completely stabilized. Even the Seven Star Weapons seem to be steadily choosing their wielders. By the way, perhaps due to his participation in this incident, the chief physician was chosen by the whip. Sakura-chan obtained the hammer. Stalker Pig, who had completed his training, acquired the Projectile Weapon. Apparently, he got it by seriously applying himself. As for the claws, there were so many candidates that they couldn’t decide. It was said that when Big Sister’s friend, Kou, and the panda we retrieved were taken near the claws, they all emitted a faint glow. Since no one had obtained them yet, it was suggested that gathering the candidates before the claws and holding a tournament to determine the strongest might be the way to secure them. A tournament was scheduled to be held soon. Similarly, it was said that the axe was showing similar signs, and it seemed that the world was steadily moving in a positive direction. Well, that’s how things are going, and the fighting force is steadily being strengthened. As for the Spirit Tortoise, perhaps thanks to Trash, there’s no sign of its seal being broken. The plan was for the Heroes to gather near the country where the Spirit Tortoise was sealed on the day it was supposed to awaken, and Rival looked off into the distance with a contemplative gaze.
“Naofumi… the Spear Hero…”
“What’s wrong, Gaelion?”
“What is it?”
Since Rival spoke in a serious tone, it piqued my interest. Well, it’s probably going to be something insignificant.
“If Naofumi and the others have to destroy the present for the sake of the world, will you do it? What do you think about saving only the chosen ones and sacrificing the rest?”
“Huh? Are you talking about the Four Spirits? Hmm…”
“More importantly, Filo-tan is what matters most to me.”
No matter what happens, I won’t stop gathering Filolials so that I can definitely reunite with her.
“The Spear Hero is as single-minded as ever. What about Naofumi?”
“Hmm… It’s difficult, but I’d prefer to choose a path where that doesn’t have to happen.”
“…I see. That’s just like Naofumi. But… in that case…”
Saying that, Rival kept gazing toward the Spirit Tortoise’s country.

What’s going on? Incidentally, the seal was never broken. Whether there was a reason or not, I had no idea. In any case, the seal would eventually break, but for now, Trash, the Queen, and the Pig King were explaining the situation to the nation where the Spirit Tortoise was sealed.

A few days passed after that. It was during the Heroes’ vacation in the village where the development was progressing. While everyone, including the Heroes, was gathered together, Father appeared with a cheerful expression.
“Everyone, everyone! I found something really interesting!”

Saying that, Father placed the creature he had brought on the table with a plop. It was a mysterious creature that looked like a mixture of a raccoon and a tanuki, yet had a somewhat comical aspect to it. Hmm? I feel like I’ve seen this creature somewhere before.
“Ra… Rafu…”
The creature stood up on two legs and raised its right front paw as if it had been made to do so. Was it just my imagination, or did its tone seem somewhat hesitant?
